# Phase

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Phase

## What it does

Phase lets you move through solid blocks by exploiting weaknesses in server-side anti-cheat systems. Depending on the server you're playing on, select the mode that matches its anti-cheat so the exploit is as effective — and as discreet — as possible.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/phase). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
